mapper.sql: h.id, h.account_id AS accountId, a.name AS accountName, h.fund_code AS fundCode, h.fund_name AS fundName, h.fund_category AS fundCategory, h.shares, h.cost_amount AS costAmount, CASE WHEN h.shares IS NULL OR h.shares = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(h.cost_amount / h.shares, 4) END AS avgCost, h.nav, h.nav_date AS navDate, h.market_value AS marketValue, ROUND(COALESCE(h.market_value, 0) - COALESCE(h.cost_amount, 0), 2) AS profitLoss, h.quote_status AS quoteStatus, h.estimated_market_value AS estimatedMarketValue, h.note, h.sort_order AS sortOrder, h.enabled, h.create_time AS createTime, h.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM finance_fund_holding h LEFT JOIN finance_account a ON a.id = h.account_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.user_id = h.user_id WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.id = #{id} AND h.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN h.quote_status = 'confirmed' THEN h.market_value ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS confirmedMarketValue, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN h.quote_status = 'delayed' THEN COALESCE(h.estimated_market_value, h.market_value) ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS laggedMarketValue, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(h.cost_amount), 0), 2) AS totalCostAmount FROM finance_fund_holding h WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.enabled = 1 AND h.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT h.account_id AS accountId, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN h.quote_status = 'confirmed' THEN h.market_value ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS confirmedMarketValue FROM finance_fund_holding h WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.enabled = 1 AND h.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY h.account_id
